_comment: SCCL v7 (Branch E of RESEARCH_NOTES_v5.md, E1 pre-registered BEFORE any v7 run, incl. a pre-run ladder correction keeping the exact v6 prefix for seed-matched determinism): pass-rate MARGIN veto. Motivation: v6 telemetry (runs/sccl_v6/telemetry_v6.json, findings F1/F4) measured 100% probe insensitivity at BOTH K=1 and K=3 — every probe-checked erosion passed its probes — because the retain rule is ANY-of-n: a probe whose regeneration quality degrades to 50% still 'passes' as long as one of n draws survives. E1 turns the veto's evidence from a binary existential into a measured pass RATE over n=cap_samples draws per probe, retained iff rate >= theta (sccl_cap_retain_mins / sccl_cap_samples_map; pooled-rate margin re-check under the bounded-damage guard; cap_rates telemetry on every theta>0 gate). theta=0 executes the exact legacy any-pass path (bit-identity). PRE-REGISTERED RULES: H1 sensitivity (strict OR majority arith > 0.375); H1b dose ordering of cap-veto counts strict >= majority >= baseline; H2 width+sensitivity (ens_strict arith >= strict arith); H3 composition (ens_strict_anchor arith AND ACC >= max of rows 4..6); BREAKTHROUGH ens_strict_anchor arith >= 0.55 AND frontier >= sccl.frontier - 0.02 -> multi-seed BEFORE any headline. DEGENERACY GUARD: a theta>0 row with < 3 accepted updates is degenerate (veto stall) and excluded from H2/H3 maxima.
